summary: Highlander Silver Corp., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, announcing the appointment of Ms. Poonam Puri as an independent director to its board, effective immediately. No terms such as stake, price, or premium are involved. The board, through management, welcomed the appointment for its governance expertise. This is a standalone director appointment, representing a routine governance update that does not trigger a special situation. The filing is a standard disclosure under Rule 13a-16 for a Canadian-listed issuer. No further regulatory or strategic changes are indicated.
